text:
opsbot: ALERT — Elevated 5xx and 504 timeouts observed from private-vpc-gateway-us-west-2 across multiple customer routes. Error rate 0.2% -> 11.8% in last 6m. Trigger: gateway-proxy-usw2-*/healthcheck 504s. Paging on-call.

lia: I'm on it, taking pager. Which customers affected? any enterprise on Dedicated?

devon: I'm on standby. quick check shows spike correlated with peered-vpc egress to partner-network (10.100.0.0/16). lots of timeouts, some 502s. Logs show downstream connections RST or no response.

alex: Support update: 3 customers reporting retries/timeouts since ~14:02 UTC, one reported failed inference requests and client-side 504s. Not full outage but high error rate.

sanjay: confirming metrics — connection errors on gateway instances in az-a and az-b, CPU/mem normal, socket backlog low, but lots of retransmits. NAT gateway metrics show unusual SNAT translation counts. 

caroline: tagging network. quick hypothesis: peering egress path has restrictive security group or route change that blocks ephemeral client ports on return traffic. I've seen asymmetric routing cause gateway 504s when replies go back via different egress.

lia: steps: 1) gather tcpdump on gateway 10.0.21.45:443, 2) check peering route tables, 3) inspect security-group egress rules for peered subnets and NAT behavior. Anyone run tcpdump? 

devon: running tcpdump on gw-host-21:
```
sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 host 10.100.5.23 and port 443 -c 200 -w /tmp/trace.pcap
``` 

caroline: meanwhile I'll diff route tables between azs and the peering attachment. `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=vpc-xyz` 

sanjay: quick curl from gw-host to peer IP returns 504 intermittently:
```
curl -i -sS -X POST https://10.100.5.23/infer -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
...
``` 

alex: rolling support note: customers should see degraded latency and occasional 5xx; advise retries and backoff.

caroline: found it — security group sg-0a12bd has a new restrictive egress rule applied at 13:58 that limits outbound ports to 443 only (no ephemeral range). Peered VPC endpoints expect ephemeral return ports; we need ephemeral range allowed for established flows. Change likely from infra change earlier today.

devon: that would explain SYN/ACK arriving but returned packets dropped. can we add a temporary rule to allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535 egress to 10.100.0.0/16?

lia: if it's safe, do quick temporary patch: authorize egress on sg-0a12bd for TCP 1024-65535 to 10.100.0.0/16. Caroline, can you do that? I'll coordinate rollback plan.

caroline: applying temporary rule now:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a12bd --ip-permissions '[{"IpProtocol":"tcp","FromPort":1024,"ToPort":65535,"IpRanges":[{"CidrIp":"10.100.0.0/16"}]}]'
``` 

caroline: rule added. monitoring.

sanjay: replaying quick synthetic tests from gateway after rule:
```
curl -i -sS -X POST https://10.100.5.23/infer -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
...tokenized payload...
``` 

devon: :tada: error rates dropping. metrics show 5xx from 11.8% -> 1.1% in 4 minutes.

alex: notified impacted customers about mitigation and that we're working on permanent fix. 

lia: root cause: security group change applied to egress for peered subnet removed ephemeral port egress; established connections require return ports. This broke traffic flow for several private deployments using peered VPCs causing gateway 5xx/504. Need postmortem and ACL change process.

caroline: planned permanent fix: update infra change control to ensure ephemeral port ranges are preserved for peered VPC rules, add unit tests in terraform, and add a monitoring alert on SG egress rule diffs. I'll open PR to enforce these rules and schedule rollout after review.

devon: also adding a graceful fallback policy in route table: if peering path fails, route to alternate egress NAT in same region (nat-0b3def) for affected prefixes.

lia: handoff to devon for night shift monitoring. I'll update incident channel with timeline and customer impact. oncall handoff: devon, you're now primary, lia handing off at 14:15 UTC.

devon: got it, taking over. I'll keep monitoring 5xx and the temporary SG rule. If we see reversion, will revert and fail traffic to nat-0b3def until infra fix. :eyes:

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation applied, ephemeral egress rule added. Error rate reduced. Incident severity downgraded to SEV3. Timeline and actions to follow in postmortem.

alex: I'll draft customer comms and add notes on mitigation timeline.

lia: thanks all, nice quick triage. Caroline please link PR and terraform plan. We'll include rollback steps in PM. 

caroline: PR #1482 opened with test case and planned rollout, linking in incidents thread.

devon: monitoring graphs look stable through 14:35 UTC. leaving synthetic checks running every 60s. If anything pops up I'll page.

sanjay: recording notes for postmortem: detection at 14:02, mitigation applied 14:07, rule added 14:08, rate normalized 14:12. 

lia: closing real-time paging. We'll convert to postmortem doc and assign actions. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
